pages.text: The $(bold)Synthesizer$() embeds 3 reagent items into a $(bold)DNA Strand$() to create a $(bold)Filled DNA Strand$(). The Filled DNA Strand is then used in the Sequencer to produce a specific strain extract.$(br)$(br)$(bold)Inputs (5 slots):$()$(br)• Slot 1: DNA Strand$(br)• Slots 2–4: $(bold)3 Reagent items$() (specific to the desired strain)$(br)• Slot 5: Output$(br)$(br)$(bold)Output:$() DNA Strand with embedded reagent data$(br)$(br)Check each Strain's guide entry for the exact 3 reagents needed.

pages.title: Example Reagents
pages.text: $(bold)White Widow$(): Bone Meal + Sugar + White Dye$(br)$(bold)OG Kush$(): Green Dye + Slime Ball + Hemp Coal$(br)$(bold)Moonbow$(): Prismarine Shard + Glow Ink Sac + Kelp$(br)$(bold)Ghost Train$(): Soul Sand + Phantom Membrane + Ghast Tear$(br)$(br)The DNA Strand item stores reagent data as a component — the resulting Filled DNA Strand looks the same but carries the embedded reagent information for the Sequencer.
